explanation: Only sine and cosine are 'primary' — the other four trig functions are built from them. Drag the angle and watch the x-leg (cos) and y-leg (sin) of the unit-circle triangle change; tan is just their ratio sin/cos, cot is the flipped ratio cos/sin, and sec and csc are the reciprocals 1/cos and 1/sin. When a denominator hits zero the function is 'undef', which is exactly where tan, cot, sec, or csc has no value.
bullets: Quotient: tan = sin/cos and cot = cos/sin (one is the other flipped).
A zero denominator (cos = 0 or sin = 0) makes that function undefined.
